visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker with short dark hair, wearing a black collared shirt, stands in front of a wooden bar shelf filled with various bottles of liquid in warm indoor lighting. He speaks directly to the camera, using active hand gestures to emphasize points. (2) Transition to a 2D animation showing a character in a Japanese military uniform holding a white flag with a red circle, while another character with a simple topknot looks on. The background is a flat grey with a '1895' date overlay. (3) A black and white historical photograph displays a traditional Japanese Torii gate in a wooded hillside setting. (4) Back to the male speaker at the bar, who continues talking with expressive facial movements and hand motions. (5) Another animation phase featuring characters sitting at a bar labeled 'TAIWAN BAR' with stylized drink glasses and a green floating spirit character. (6) The speaker returns, gesturing broadly with his hands. (7) Scenic shots of a modern park follow, featuring a white bridge over a green pond, dense green trees, and a light-colored elephant sculpture integrated into a stone pillar. (8) A white document with vertical text columns is shown briefly, followed by old black and white photos of people at a playground. (9) The speaker is shown again, followed by shots of 'Taipei Expo Park' signage, a large colorful Ferris wheel against a bright sky, and a stone wall with 'Taipei Zoo' and its logo. (10) A vibrant poster for 'Beelu's Yum Yum Time' and 'Dream Adventure King' appears, featuring a black bear character and food icons. (11) Footage of an indoor event space follows, showing children in masks playing in a large blue ball pit. A large digital projection of the bear character is visible on the wall behind them. (12) The speaker concludes at the bar, pointing downward toward the bottom of the frame.
